shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Levels and per-level size are bought from a 146,000-cell budget; colder with altitude, richer ore and more cave with depth. Multi-level rendering, interaction and group ordering all verified in play.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. ~60 files / ~15,800 LOC.

## Pitch
Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z** from the deepest basement; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing**. Per-level sizes 126 / 190 / 254, each just under a 64 boundary (~1-2% gutter waste).

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched**. **But reachability ≠ a path** — 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Path grid is an IJobParallelFor over EVERY cell ⇒ **total stacked cells is the runtime metric** · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — cell budget = **146,000**
Player buys level COUNT and per-level DIMENSION from one budget on the advanced-config screen. `4 × 190 = 145,920` is what sets the figure; `2 × 254 = 130,048`, `7 × 126 = 112,896`; `5 × 190 = 182,400` and `7 × 190 = 255,360` refused (3-up-and-3-down at 190 auto-drops the size to 126 — the intended trade).
`ABMapSizeLimit` owns it: `UpperLevels`/`LowerLevels` (0-3 each), `BandCount`, `SurfaceBand = lower`, `Fits`, `MaxSize`, `MaxLevelsFor`, `StackedCells`. `ABV2.BandCount`/`SurfaceBand` are properties (were consts — the only thing pinning the mod to 3 levels).

### ⚠ THE CHOOSER UI — own the widget, don't patch the data
**`Dialog_AdvancedGameConfig.MapSizes` is `static readonly` and the reflection swap of it SILENTLY FAILED in play.** Vanilla's Small/Medium/Large group headers only render for sizes 200/250/300, so their presence in a screenshot proved our array was never in use. Worse, the postfix re-snapped `GameInitData.mapSize` **every frame**, undoing every click.
**Now:** our own radio buttons write `mapSize` directly; every vanilla size is locked outright; the strip shows cells-used-vs-budget and "this size affords up to N levels". Window grown +260px tall / ≥1000 wide via an `InitialSize` postfix — **vanilla lays its columns from the top and never consults the height, so added space is ours.**

# 3. CROSS-BAND MOVEMENT
Segmented at ONE interception: `StartPath` prefix → tick sweep carries the pawn → `Carry` re-issues `StartPath`. `ABWormhole.TryGetTransit` **BFSes the band graph** and returns the best pair whose far band is `hops-1` from the target; chaining is free because each leg re-plans, and hops must strictly decrease or pawns ping-pong.
**Caveat:** an intermediate level must be walkable between arrival and the next staircase; sky levels are mostly impassable open air, so stacked stair towers work and scattered flights strand a pawn. **STILL UNTESTED IN PLAY.**

# 4. GROUP ORDERING — three wrong layers before the right one
1. `FloatMenuMakerMap.GetOptions` clickPos — **wrong layer**. 2. Per-pawn `RCellFinder.BestOrderedGotoDestNear` prefix — **fought vanilla's formation**. 3. **Correct:** `RecomputeDestinations` spreads the selection ALONG the drag line; with endpoints on different bands that line runs through the GUTTER. The odd/even signature ("3 and 5 fail, 2 and 4 don't") is the proof: only ODD counts sample exactly 0.5. Fix = normalise `start`/`end` into the commanded pawns' band. **Verified fixed.**
`MultiPawnGotoController.Draw` is re-emitted with positions lifted into the view band; carries `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]` because Verse flags ANY type with a `Material` field.

# 5. ⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE — `ABBands.TryResolveVisibleBelow`
Descends while each level is see-through, stops at the first opaque floor or the bottom band, returns the accumulated `drop`. **NINE systems share it:** `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2`, `ABBelowClickThrough`, `ABBelowOverlays`, `ABBelowDynamicDraw`, `ABBelowSelectionDraw`, `ABBelowMultiSelect`, `SectionLayer_ABBelowWatergen`, `SectionLayer_ABBelowShadows`, `SectionLayer_ABBelowEdgeShadows`.
A single `- Slot` step works on a 3-level map and breaks the instant two see-through levels stack. **This bug has now appeared SEVEN times.** #6/#7 were the shadow layers — from +1 the single step lands on the opaque surface and works; from +2/+3 it lands in OPEN AIR, which holds no edifices. **VERIFIED FIXED IN PLAY (run #168).**
**Sun-shadow subtlety:** that layer's mask is *neighbour*-based (a mountain-edge caster sits under an opaque cap and can never resolve a descent of its own), so mask and descent are answered together by `TryResolveDropAround`, taking the **smallest** drop among the nine cells.
**Still single-band:** the realtime-things pass in `ABBelowDynamicDraw` (motes, fire).

# 6. SKY-MASS PRESENTATION — verified in play
**⚠ FOUR REJECTED ATTEMPTS — do not revisit:** force-linked wall masks · high-queue cover · wall-sprite suppression · theorising twice about "flat" mountains before running the below-layer report.
Despeckle (**wall dissolves only at 7+ open neighbours** — at 6 it ate the outermost wall row off every meadow edge) · one central fog hole · five-terrain plateau palette · cliff faces · alpine pass (shallow-only tarns, per-cell 6-cell edge rule, rim scree via `"Chunk"+defName`, exposure-thinned flora).
**Cross-band decoration:** `EmitMassSilhouetteAt` + `EmitMeadowFadeAt` emit into ANY layer at a z offset. Diagnosed from a below-layer report showing **no edge material at all** — the decoration lived in the other band's mesh.
**Ore glyph bug:** ore defs have no `naturalTerrain` ⇒ a "can't happen" fallback drew the whole **atlas sheet** per cell.

# 6b. ⚠ WATER — `ABWaterV2.cs`. **1.6 water is a TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE effect**
`SectionLayer_Watergen` renders `TerrainDef.waterDepthMaterial` into the **WaterDepth SUBCAMERA's** render texture (its own Unity layer), and the visible `Map/TerrainWater` material samples that (`_WaterOutputTex`) **at its own screen position**. Printing the water material where the depth pass never wrote yields **nothing at all**.

- **Water vanished from any upper level.** Half a two-pass effect was missing. Fixed by `SectionLayer_ABBelowWatergen` — mirrors vanilla's `internal` Watergen (`waterDepthMaterial` + water-to-water edge fans), descends via `TryResolveVisibleBelow`, **overrides `DrawLayer` to target `SubcameraDefOf.WaterDepth.LayerId`**. Bisect toggle: *below water depth*. Probable, **not isolated with the toggle yet**.
- **Rivers "did not generate" — VERIFIED FIXED.** `GetRiverCenter` picks `Rand.Range(0.3f,0.7f) × map.Size.z`, a fraction of the whole STACK. Remapped into the surface band preserving the *roll*. Patched on `GetRiverCenter`, **not** `Init` (Init consumes the centre immediately); delta/confluence/headwater/island inherit it. **`TileMutatorWorker_Lake.GetLakeCenter` needs the same patch or it undoes the first** — `River.Init` prefers an existing `lakeCenter`. Proof (run #167): node `start=(-25,0,155.9) end=(215,0,33.5)`, `band 0 baseRiver=3079`, all others `0`.
- **⚠ REJECTED — DO NOT RETRY: republishing `_MapSize` as one band.** Fitted every symptom including its uniformity, and was **DISPROVED IN ONE LAUNCH**: banding the global is what MAKES water run north-south. Airtight because `surfaceBand=0` made the fold the identity, so flow data was bit-identical and `_MapSize.y` was the only variable. The folded REPEAT-wrapped flow texture went with it.
- **OPEN: what actually caused "lakes flow north-south".** Leading theory is the **ghost river** (pre-fix, a carved-away sky river still produced a flow field). **Free discriminator:** watch a sky **tarn** (still water). Calm ⇒ ghost river. Flowing ⇒ separate live bug. **A RIVER-FREE tile is the STRONGER test** — no ghost field exists at all, so a flowing tarn there indicts the null-`_WaterOffsetTex` default.

# 6c. DUBS MINT MINIMAP — active level only (`DubsMintMinimapCompat.cs`)
Reflection-only, no compile-time reference, **no foreign type in any signature** — HarmonyBoot's class processor walks a patch class's method list, so a Dubs type in a parameter would throw "Could not resolve type" and be logged as a broken patch class whenever the mod is absent (the old Rimefeller ghost-warning bug). Hence `object` for the instance, and the bridge class carries no patch attribute. Detection is by **type presence**, not packageId (the Steam copy suffixes `_steam`).
**THE FIX IS ONE RECT, NOT SEVEN PATCHES.** Their six draw passes (pawns, fires, projectiles, pings, thing locators, camera box) all take the same `radarRect` and are all LINEAR in position, always `LerpDoubleClamped(0, map.Size.z, rect.height, 0, pos.z)`. Solving `rect.y + rect.height*(1 - z/Size.z) == view.height*(1 - (z-bandMin)/H)` gives `height = view.height*Size.z/H`, `y = view.height*(H + bandMin - Size.z)/H` — an over-tall rect slid so exactly the active band fills the window. Their unmodified passes then land every marker correctly.
**Culling comes free:** other bands map outside the window and their draw already runs inside `GUI.BeginClip`, so no per-pass filter is needed.
**The one thing that cannot be reused is their texture blit.** `Widgets.DrawTextureFitted(rect, tex, 1f, 1f)` binds to the `(Rect, Texture, float scale, float alpha)` overload, which fits **preserving the TEXTURE's own aspect** — fine on a square vanilla map where fitted rect == marker rect, but on a 190×768 stack it letterboxes the map into a narrow sliver and the two stop agreeing. Drawn here with `ScaleMode.StretchToFill` at exactly the marker rect.
Also: `UpdateMapTex` is prefixed to refresh **only the active band's cells** (their version runs `procCell` over every cell — 7× the work for levels nobody can see); texture/pixel/dirty arrays stay full-map-sized at unchanged coordinates, and a band switch forces one full pass. `procCell` is bound as a real delegate because it is per-cell hot; everything else stays on MethodInfo (≤6 invokes/frame). We never reinitialise their texture — the Unity API was renamed across versions (`Resize`→`Reinitialize`), so their build calls its own and we stand aside until sizes agree. `CameraDriver.CurrentRealPosition` is **private** (Dubs publicises Assembly-CSharp); `Find.Camera.transform.position` is the same value through public API. GUI clip/group pops are in a `finally` — Unity's clip stack is global and an unbalanced pop corrupts every later window.
**BUILT, NEVER RUN.** Dubs is currently INACTIVE in the user's mod list; testing needs it enabled and passed as a companion mod.

# 7. PER-LEVEL CHARACTER
Sky temp `-4°C × level` (compounds) · basement flat -6 · ore `×(1+0.45×(depth-1))`, cave openness `×(1+0.35×(depth-1))`, both AFTER the settings clamp · mountains taper upward for free.
**Snow line:** generation-time snow seeding **REMOVED** (a pre-frozen top level read as a different biome instead of higher ground). Nothing lost: vanilla accumulates/melts snow per-CELL temperature and the per-level offset already makes high levels cold, so the line is earned rather than painted on at t=0.

# 8. CAMERA
`freeCameraPan` REMOVED. `ABCameraBounds.For(level)` keyed by **level**; `panMargin 63.5` for +1/+3, **`maxZoom` left DERIVED** (an absolute would mis-scale a 190 band). `Dialog_ABCameraCalibration` opens with the clamp UNLOCKED — **a calibration tool must suspend the limit it calibrates.** Clamp bails while `Scribe` is active or state isn't `Playing`.

# 9. ⚠ GENERATION COST — the top open item
| Config | Cells | Carve | Things destroyed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 × 190 | 109,440 | 5.0 s | 14,971 |
| 4 × 126 | 64,512 | 3.0 s | 24,490 |
| 7 × 126 | 112,896 | 30.4 s | 62,686 |
| 4 × 190 (early) | 145,920 | 20.4 s | 79,706 |
| 4 × 190 (#167, **river** tile) | 145,920 | 18.7 s | 56,318 |
| 4 × 190 (#168, **river-free** tile) | 145,920 | **2.5 s** | **15,787** |
**`Sky clear` is ~97% of the carve**, and **`0 rocks spawned`**: everything destroyed is vanilla content generated into doomed bands and immediately deleted.
**⚠ THE REAL DRIVER IS BIOME CONTENT, NOT CELL COUNT.** #167 vs #168 at *identical* 4×190: **3.6× the things cost 7.5× the time.** Superlinear, as the linear-`ListerThings.Remove` theory predicts. **Any future carve timing MUST record the tile or it is not comparable.**
Band 1's sky clear is consistently ~3× bands 2-3 — vanilla fills the first sky band most densely, so scope it first. #167's biggest genstep was `MutatorPostTerrain` at 3646 ms (river `GeneratePostTerrain`).
**THE FIX — extend the doomed-band genstep skip.** Precedent: `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABSkipDoomedBands` took generation 16.9 s → 4.2 s. Targets: `RocksFromGrid`, `Terrain`, `RockChunks`, `Plants`, `ScatterRuinsSimple`, `CaveHives`, `MutatorPostElevationFertility`.
**HARD CONSTRAINT: per-cell gensteps scope safely; `map.Area`-count scatterers do NOT.** Audit `ScatterShrines`/`ScatterRuinsSimple` individually. **Do not blanket-skip the water mutators** — §6b needs them, just anchored correctly.

# 10. RUNTIME PERF — 59.6 fps @96 pawns, mod ≈2% frame. All rendering is bake-time section-mesh geometry.

# 11. VERTICAL LINKS — elevator SHIPPED, **untested**. Full-mesh 2×2; O(n²) in band count. Known: `Carry` latent hole.

# 12. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · **below layer report** (submesh dump — use it BEFORE theorising) · below pawn report · **water report** (per-band water/withDepthMat/baseRiver census + riverGraph + flow map + published `_MapSize`) · transit health · stuck probe · transit logging · lighting/shader/biome reports · bisect toggles (click-through, below multi-select, below terrain/things/air-mask/lighting, **below water depth**) · ABGenProfile · camera calibration · `CliffFaceDepth`.

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **Test Dubs minimap compat** (§6c) — built, never run; needs Dubs enabled as a companion.
2. **Two water questions** (§6b): isolate the below-water depth pass with its toggle, settle the tarn calm/flowing discriminator.
3. **Doomed-band genstep scoping pass** (§9) — biggest remaining win; band 1 first, record the tile.
4. **Map Preview** (`m00nl1ght.MapPreview`) — specced, not written. It never sees our banding: `MapPreviewRequest` runs only `ElevationFertility`/`Terrain`/`MutatorPost*` on its own map, **never through `MapGenerator.GenerateMap`**, sized from `world.info.initialMapSize` which we keep at the SURFACE size. So it previews a normal square map while the real surface band is a horizontal slice of a much taller one — different noise entirely. Fix = generate at the inflated height, crop the texture to the surface band. **Reflection-only** (Lunar component, dynamically loaded). Hooks: `MapPreviewAPI.IsGeneratingPreview`, `MapSizeUtility.MapSizeOverride`, `MapPreviewRequest.TextureSize`.
5. **Never exercised in play:** multi-hop stair router (needs a stair tower), elevator, reload fix, lake-anchor patch.
6. Realtime-things pass still single-band (motes/fire >1 level down).
7. Selection bracket **drifts upward as you zoom out** — that path mixes world and screen space; our offset is in world units.
8. **Option E — waterfalls**: de-risked once the below-water depth pass is confirmed.
9. COMBAT never verified · Option C parked · vertical conduit · compat audit incl. Better Mountains · transplant (coastline slicing) · **store page still says three levels**.

# 14. LESSONS (telegraphic)
**Run the diagnostic before the third theory** · **build the A/B discriminator INTO any change whose mechanism you cannot read** — the `_MapSize` theory fitted every symptom and was still WRONG; the toggle cost one launch instead of a release · **a beautiful fit is not evidence** · **poll the monitor even when nothing auto-prompts** — single-occurrence `[RimWorld]` warnings are filtered, and one was ours · **when N call sites share ONE linear mapping, re-aim the shared parameter instead of patching N sites** (Dubs: one rect replaced seven patches, and the existing clip did the culling) · **an odd/even or count-dependent symptom is arithmetic** · **a UNIFORM symptom is a scale/constant, a PATCHY one is data** · **when a symptom says "X is missing", ask how many PASSES X takes** · measure, don't extrapolate · **two runs of the same config are only comparable if the TILE matches** — identical 4×190 varied 7.5× · **a single-step assumption survives until the data has two steps — grep `X + 1`, `== N`, every `- Slot`; SEVEN times now** · **generation anchors picked as a fraction of `map.Size.z` all land in the wrong band** · **patch the method that PRODUCES a value, not the one that stores it, when the storer consumes it immediately** · **own the widget instead of patching the data it reads; `static readonly` reflection writes fail silently** · **check which OVERLOAD a foreign call binds to** — `DrawTextureFitted(r,t,1f,1f)` is `(scale, alpha)`, not `(scale, texProportions)`, and it preserves the TEXTURE's aspect · **never fight the player's input every frame** · never hide sprites that carry gameplay information · visual noise in generated content is a GENERATION bug · ore defs have no naturalTerrain · a `Graphic_Linked` base material is the whole ATLAS SHEET · **"can't happen" fallbacks are what the player photographs** · enforce spatial rules PER CELL, not seed+radius · **balance GUI clip/group pops in a `finally`** — Unity's clip stack is global · **a foreign mod's publicised Assembly-CSharp lets THEM touch private members you cannot** — find the public equivalent · **never put a foreign type in a patch-class signature** · key authored tables by stable semantics, not index · a per-leg re-planning router needs only the FIRST HOP of a BFS · **normalise the anchor, don't rewrite each member** · clip geometry to cells you own · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak — CWT, or store the id only as a change DETECTOR · **Unity textures are not GC'd with their owner** · **any type with a `Material` field needs `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]` even if resolved lazily** · never cache comps while Scribe active · FinalizeInit = worker thread · `material.shader =` resets renderQueue · `SectionLayer` subclasses are **auto-discovered** by `Section`'s ctor.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: `astryl.Circinus` + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework` — **drop them when a bug might not be ours** (runs #167/#168 ran clean with none). **Dubs minimap tests need `dubwise.dubsmintminimap` passed as a companion — it is INACTIVE in the user's real list.** Multi-level tests need `quicktest=false`. Reload tests need load-while-playing. **Water/river tests need a tile that actually has a river or lake landmark**, a fresh colony, and the tile noted in any perf comparison. **A `surfaceBand=0` config cannot test band-folded addressing.**
